phase1.name: Phase 1 — Single Shot Reveal
phase1.prompt: Extremely close-up, shallow depth of field. Two Indian hands of a male person gently lower a dark matte black sci-fi mechanical egg onto a highly reflective grey marble ledge, then completely withdraw. Immediately, a continuous smooth transformation begins: the egg's vertical seam panels mechanically fold outward laterally like the opening petals of a mechanical lotus flower, while a cross-shaped stabilizer base deploys with four rectangular extensions pointing outwards. As the panels flare wide open, a vertical telescoping rod rises straight up from the center core. From within this core, a flawless miniature black Adiyogi Shiva bust (a serene male face with matted hair and a white teardrop tilak on the forehead) slowly emerges upward. The bust seamlessly finishes assembling, revealing large circular hoop earrings, a pearl bead necklace, and a prominent white crescent moon symbol materializing on its forehead. Directly beneath the bust, a miniature temple architecture base with pillars and a gopuram completes its formation. The miniature bust and temple base sit perfectly centered, echoing the massive real Adiyogi Shiva statue blurred majestically in the background on the exact same vertical axis. The camera performs a very slow, subtle cinematic push-in. 9:16 vertical orientation, photorealistic cinematic lighting, exact mechanical physics simulation.

transformation.prompt: Low ominous drone building up tension, subtle Damaru (Shiva's drum) rhythm begins slowly and builds up with a rising bass undertone, mystical and tense, three mechanical lock-clicks, then sudden silence.

music.prompt: Majestic awe-inspiring devotional score, sudden divine swell of an Om Namah Shivaya ambient chant layered with a Tibetan singing bowl and a Carnatic nadaswaram burst, ending on a single long fading resonant OM bell.
